title: ‘The Run-Up’: The Republican Party Sorts Through Its Mess

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我那个黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Today we're sharing the first episode of the new season of our politics show, The Run-Up.
sentences.zh: 今天我们要分享我们政治节目《冲刺》新一季的第一集。

sentences.en: If you listened to the first season, which ran here on The Daily, you'll remember that it told the story of the lead-up to the midterms,
sentences.zh: 如果你听过第一季（在《每日新闻》播出的那一季），你就会记得它讲述了中期选举前夕的故事，

sentences.en: how we got to that moment where Americans on both sides of the aisle were feeling so hopeless and where the stakes of the election seemed to be democracy itself.
sentences.zh: 讲述了我们是如何走到那个时刻的：美国两党选民都感到如此绝望，而选举的赌注似乎就是民主本身。

sentences.en: A lot of that story was about the grassroots and their disconnect with the establishment, a story many years in the making.
sentences.zh: 那个故事很大程度上是关于草根阶层及其与建制派之间的脱节，这是一个酝酿多年的故事。

sentences.en: This year, the run-up is turning its attention to the other side, to the establishment, the party insiders.
sentences.zh: 今年，《冲刺》将目光转向了另一方——建制派，也就是党内核心人士。

sentences.en: And that's because this is a very particular moment in American politics.
sentences.zh: 这是因为这是美国政治中一个非常特殊的时刻。

sentences.en: The midterms seemed to send a very clear message that voters were rejecting extremism and election denialism, and really, Donald Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 中期选举似乎传递了一个非常明确的信息：选民正在拒绝极端主义、选举否认论，以及唐纳德·特朗普本人。

sentences.en: So how, in the aftermath of those results, would the parties move forward, especially with Trump seeking re-election and an indictment looming?
sentences.zh: 那么，在选举结果出炉后，各党派将如何前进？尤其是在特朗普寻求连任且面临起诉的情况下？

sentences.en: How would they try to position themselves, and what would they try to do in these months when no one is really paying attention?
sentences.zh: 他们会如何定位自己？在这些无人关注的月份里，他们又会尝试做些什么？

sentences.en: That's where The Run-Up picks back up this season, and the story starts inside the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 这就是本季《冲刺》重新切入的地方，故事从共和党内部开始。

sentences.en: Take a listen.
sentences.zh: 听听看。

sentences.en: Should we hit the road?
sentences.zh: 我们要出发了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, let's see.
sentences.zh: 是的，看看吧。

sentences.en: So back in January, I flew out to Dana Point, California, and met up with my colleagues, Caitlin O'Keefe and Luke Vander Plukk.
sentences.zh: 一月份的时候，我飞往加利福尼亚州的达纳角，见到了我的同事凯特琳·奥基夫和卢克·范德·普鲁克。

sentences.en: We're headed to the Waldorf Astoria that is the host hotel for the Republican National Committee's winter meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们正前往华尔道夫酒店，那是共和党全国委员会冬季会议的举办地。

sentences.en: And that's basically where the leadership of the inside of the Republican Party will hear out the candidates and then make a selection for the next RNC chair.
sentences.zh: 基本上，共和党内部的领导层将在那里听取候选人的意见，然后选出下一任共和党全国委员会主席。

sentences.en: And that's all happening at this very bougie, very exclusive, very expensive hotel in Orange County, and that's where we're headed.
sentences.zh: 这一切都发生在这个位于橙县、非常高档、非常排外、非常昂贵的酒店里，而我们正要去那里。

sentences.en: Right, like minimum $900 a night.
sentences.zh: 没错，每晚至少900美元。

sentences.en: Like, minimum.
sentences.zh: 至少。

sentences.en: The meeting we were here for is not a highly publicized event.
sentences.zh: 我们参加的这次会议并不是一个广为人知的活动。

sentences.en: In fact, its members would rather the media not show up at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，成员们宁愿媒体根本不要出现。

sentences.en: But it seemed like the place to go.
sentences.zh: 但这里似乎是必去之地。

sentences.en: It's the first Republican meeting of the year, and I think what we're trying to do here is figure out how honestly are Republicans reckoning with their midterms losses.
sentences.zh: 这是共和党今年的第一次会议，我想我们在这里试图弄清楚的是，共和党人对中期选举的失利到底有多诚恳地进行了反思。

sentences.en: Because while the committee had a clear agenda for the week, they're debating about whether a new chair is necessary for the party to move forward in a positive direction.
sentences.zh: 因为虽然委员会对这一周有明确的议程，但他们正在争论是否需要一位新主席来带领党派向积极的方向发展。

sentences.en: It all felt tied up in this much larger story about the party and the fractures that have formed after the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与关于该党以及中期选举后形成的裂痕的更大故事交织在一起。

sentences.en: After targeting Kevin McCarthy in the speaker fight, the grassroots had now turned on the RNC chair, Ronna Romney McDaniel.
sentences.zh: 在众议院议长之争中针对凯文·麦卡锡之后，草根阶层现在将矛头转向了共和党全国委员会主席罗娜·罗姆尼·麦克丹尼尔。
zh_words: 罗娜·罗姆尼·麦克丹尼尔

sentences.en: She's the niece of Mitt Romney, though she rarely uses the Romney name these days.
sentences.zh: 她是米特·罗姆尼的侄女，尽管她现在很少使用罗姆尼这个姓氏。

sentences.en: And if she were to win, she'd become one of the longest-serving chairs in Republican Party history.
sentences.zh: 如果她获胜，她将成为共和党历史上任期最长的主席之一。

sentences.en: But for weeks leading up to the vote, members of the Trump wing had been working to block that.
sentences.zh: 但在投票前的几周里，特朗普派系的成员一直在努力阻止这一点。

sentences.en: And using right-wing media to promote her challenger, another RNC member, Harmeet Dillon.
sentences.zh: 并利用右翼媒体来宣传她的挑战者，另一位共和党全国委员会成员哈米特·迪伦。

sentences.en: Dillon is a prominent conservative lawyer who'd helped Donald Trump with his election fraud claiMs.
sentences.zh: 迪伦是一位著名的保守派律师，曾帮助唐纳德·特朗普处理他的选举舞弊指控。

sentences.en: Interestingly, Trump himself had publicly stayed out of the race.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，特朗普本人公开置身于这场竞选之外。

sentences.en: He'd handpicked McDaniel for the chair seat back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 早在2016年，他曾亲自挑选麦克丹尼尔担任主席一职。

sentences.en: And according to some reports, he was quietly still supporting her.
sentences.zh: 据一些报道称，他私下里仍在支持她。

sentences.en: Like the party as a whole in this moment, it was a mess of tangled lines and scrambled allegiances.
sentences.zh: 就像此时的整个共和党一样，这是一团纠缠不清的线条和混乱的忠诚关系。

sentences.en: And GOP officials were talking about the upcoming chair vote as the first step toward unity.
sentences.zh: 共和党官员们正在谈论即将到来的主席投票，将其作为迈向团结的第一步。

sentences.en: Right, right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对，对。

sentences.en: So this is sort of like potentially one moment of reckoning for the party that we're here to be sort of witness to.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是我们在此见证的党派清算时刻之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think Republicans are going to have a bunch of moments of reckoning.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为共和党人将面临一系列的清算时刻。

sentences.en: I think we're here not only to bear witness to another one, but really to kind of gauge what we can learn by how it shakes out.
sentences.zh: 我想我们在这里不仅是为了见证另一个时刻，更是为了衡量我们能从事情的发展中了解到什么。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Asted Herndon.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是阿斯特德·赫恩登。

sentences.en: This is the run-up.
sentences.zh: 这是《冲刺》。

sentences.en: So before we go in, where are we right now?
sentences.zh: 那么在进去之前，我们现在在哪里？

sentences.en: Like, what is this?
sentences.zh: 这是什么地方？

sentences.en: What is the thing we're doing?
sentences.zh: 我们正在做的事情是什么？

sentences.en: We have transitioned from the stoplight to a residence inn.
sentences.zh: 我们已经从红绿灯路口转到了万豪旗下的Residence Inn酒店。

sentences.en: So the RNC's winter meeting is a three-day event.
sentences.zh: 共和党全国委员会的冬季会议是一个为期三天的活动。

sentences.en: And on day one, before heading to the Waldorf for the main meeting, we stop by another hotel down the road.
sentences.zh: 第一天，在前往华尔道夫参加主要会议之前，我们顺道去了路边的另一家酒店。

sentences.en: And this is where the conservative radio host, John Fredericks, is hosting a forum.
sentences.zh: 保守派电台主持人约翰·弗雷德里克斯正在那里主持一场论坛。

sentences.en: Where conservative media was putting on a candidate forum for the chair fight.
sentences.zh: 保守派媒体正在那里为党主席之争举办一场候选人论坛。

sentences.en: It was being broadcast on John Fredericks' radio show, on Steve Bannon's show, War Room, and on Far Right TV.
sentences.zh: 它正在约翰·弗雷德里克斯的广播节目、史蒂夫·班农的《作战室》节目以及极右翼电视台上播出。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's like we have a commercial break.
sentences.zh: 就像我们进入了广告时间一样。

sentences.en: Like, can you just, real quick, describe the table, who's sitting at it, who's not sitting at it?
sentences.zh: 你能快速描述一下那张桌子吗？谁坐在那里，谁没坐在那里？

sentences.en: On the left, you have an empty seat for Ronna McDaniel, who's the RNC chair.
sentences.zh: 左边是共和党全国委员会主席罗娜·麦克丹尼尔的空座位。

sentences.en: They're trying to make sure they show that she has chosen not to come.
sentences.zh: 他们试图确保展示出她选择了不来。

sentences.en: You have the surrogate for Harmeet Dillon's challenging campaign.
sentences.zh: 那里有哈米特·迪伦挑战竞选活动的代理人。

sentences.en: You have Mike Lindell seated there, who is the Trump supporter and MyPillow CEO.
sentences.zh: 迈克·林德尔坐在那里，他是特朗普的支持者和MyPillow的首席执行官。

sentences.en: You can learn a lot by just looking at this table.
sentences.zh: 光看这张桌子就能学到很多东西。

sentences.en: For one, McDaniel is not there.
sentences.zh: 首先，麦克丹尼尔不在那里。

sentences.en: Event organizers say they invited her.
sentences.zh: 活动组织者说他们邀请了她。

sentences.en: She says they never did.
sentences.zh: 她说他们从来没邀请过。

sentences.en: Dillon has sent a spokesperson.
sentences.zh: 迪伦派了一位发言人。

sentences.en: The only one who's actually there is the third candidate, the long-shot, far-right figure, Mike Lindell.
sentences.zh: 唯一真正到场的是第三位候选人，那位胜算渺茫的极右翼人物迈克·林德尔。

sentences.en: But the room is packed.
sentences.zh: 但房间里挤满了人。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like a sort of a conference room in a hotel.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像酒店里的会议室一样。

sentences.en: And it's, you know, people standing in the side, standing in the back.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们站在旁边，站在后面。

sentences.en: I'm seeing a lot of, like, American flags.
sentences.zh: 我看到很多美国国旗。

sentences.en: It's like an American flag cowboy hat.
sentences.zh: 还有一顶美国国旗图案的牛仔帽。

sentences.en: Oh, here we go again.
sentences.zh: 哦，又来了。

sentences.en: The forum is set up as a debate.
sentences.zh: 论坛被设定为一场辩论。

sentences.en: And the main focus is why the party keeps losing.
sentences.zh: 主要焦点是为什么该党一直在输。

sentences.en: The last two years, the biggest thing that we needed was a fair playing field.
sentences.zh: 过去两年，我们最需要的是一个公平的竞争环境。

sentences.en: We need our election platforms fixed, bar none.
sentences.zh: 我们需要修复我们的选举平台，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Whether it's machines being gone, whether it's voter rolls being cleaned.
sentences.zh: 无论是取消机器投票，还是清理选民名单。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of moments.
sentences.zh: 但有很多时刻。

sentences.en: This is something that Harmeet is very, very passionate about.
sentences.zh: 这是哈米特非常、非常热衷的事情。

sentences.en: She's been an election integrity lawyer for some time now, too.
sentences.zh: 她也担任选举诚信律师有一段时间了。

sentences.en: I will say one of the things when Harmeet wins is the first thing she'd like to do is bring Mike Lindell on board to help us sort out what is going on with the election.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，哈米特获胜后想做的第一件事就是让迈克·林德尔加入，帮助我们理清选举中到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: When they're mostly just agreeing with each other.
sentences.zh: 当他们大多只是在互相赞同时。

sentences.en: What did Ronald McDaniel do to fix any of it?
sentences.zh: 罗娜·麦克丹尼尔做了什么来修复这一切？

sentences.en: We just went into the 2020 election and Ronald was on TV saying we had bad candidates and it's Hershel Walker's fault.
sentences.zh: 我们刚进入2020年大选，罗娜就在电视上说我们候选人很差，那是赫歇尔·沃克的错。

sentences.en: It was not bad candidates.
sentences.zh: 那不是候选人差的问题。

sentences.en: It is not real elections.
sentences.zh: 那不是真正的选举。

sentences.en: We have to recognize that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须认识到这一点。

sentences.en: The midterms aren't Donald Trump's fault.
sentences.zh: 中期选举不是唐纳德·特朗普的错。

sentences.en: We've lost three cycles in a row.
sentences.zh: 我们已经连续输了三个周期了。

sentences.en: And you don't just get to fail upwards.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是一味地失败却还升职。

sentences.en: If you owned a football team and you lost three seasons in a row, you would either fire the head coach or at minimum you'd trade some players.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有一支橄榄球队，并且连续输了三个赛季，你要么解雇主教练，要么至少会交易一些球员。

sentences.en: Right now we're doing neither.
sentences.zh: 现在我们两者都没做。

sentences.en: We're not trading players.
sentences.zh: 我们没有交易球员。

sentences.en: We're being the same head coach and we're expecting a different result.
sentences.zh: 我们留着同一个主教练，却期待着不同的结果。

sentences.en: And that's the definition of insanity.
sentences.zh: 这就是疯狂的定义。

sentences.en: The midterms were McDaniel's fault.
sentences.zh: 中期选举是麦克丹尼尔的错。

sentences.en: And she has to go.
sentences.zh: 她必须走人。

sentences.en: Okay, folks, we have run out of time.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，我们的时间到了。

sentences.en: So we're going to do the closing statement.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要进行总结陈词。

sentences.en: I'm recording with the Times.
sentences.zh: 我正在为《时报》录音。

sentences.en: I know you've been talking to our producer, Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 我知道你一直在和我们的制片人凯特琳交谈。

sentences.en: Caitlin, yes.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，是的。

sentences.en: Not me.
sentences.zh: 不是我。

sentences.en: I'm Luke.
sentences.zh: 我是卢克。

sentences.en: After the forum, Luke and I went to the hotel lobby to catch up with John Fredericks.
sentences.zh: 论坛结束后，我和卢克去了酒店大堂找约翰·弗雷德里克斯叙旧。
zh_words: 约翰·弗雷德里克斯叙旧

sentences.en: Actually, can you just say your name and where you...
sentences.zh: 其实，你能说一下你的名字和你……

sentences.en: John Fredericks, radio and TV, at JF Radio.
sentences.zh: 约翰·弗雷德里克斯，广播和电视，JF电台。

sentences.en: Or, as he often refers to himself on his radio show.
sentences.zh: 或者，正如他在广播节目中经常自称的那样。

sentences.en: You should say the Godzilla of truth.
sentences.zh: 你应该说‘真理哥斯拉’。

sentences.en: This is the time to say it.
sentences.zh: 现在是说出来的时候了。

sentences.en: John Fredericks, I am the Godzilla of truth in America.
sentences.zh: 约翰·弗雷德里克斯，我是美国的真理哥斯拉。

sentences.en: You can follow me at JF Radio Show.
sentences.zh: 你可以在JF广播节目上关注我。

sentences.en: The Godzilla of truth.
sentences.zh: 真理哥斯拉。

sentences.en: He's hosting this forum as a way to draw grassroots attention to the RNC and their process for electing the party chair.
sentences.zh: 他举办这个论坛是为了引起草根阶层对共和党全国委员会及其党主席选举程序的关注。

sentences.en: What we're doing is we're bringing transparency back so that our base understands how this works.
sentences.zh: 我们正在做的是带回透明度，以便我们的基础选民了解这是如何运作的。

sentences.en: See, before we started doing this, they had no idea.
sentences.zh: 你看，在我们开始这样做之前，他们根本不知道。

sentences.en: They had no idea even who these 168 people were.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不知道这168个人是谁。

sentences.en: If you look at the level of corruption that goes on here, they won't let the media in until Friday.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这里发生的腐败程度，他们直到周五才让媒体进入。

sentences.en: You can't even get credentials to Friday.
sentences.zh: 你甚至拿不到周五的采访证。

sentences.en: You can't even go down the hallway without that Gestapo there, right?
sentences.zh: 你甚至不能在没有那个‘盖世太保’在场的情况下走过走廊，对吧？

sentences.en: Then they hold it at a resort where nobody can get to.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把它办在一个没人能去到的度假村里。

sentences.en: You go to breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 你去吃早餐。

sentences.en: I've been there two days.
sentences.zh: 我已经在那里待了两天了。

sentences.en: I had two breakfasts with my wife.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子吃了两顿早餐。

sentences.en: Both of them 120 bucks.
sentences.zh: 两顿都花了120美元。

sentences.en: Who can afford that, right?
sentences.zh: 谁负担得起，对吧？

sentences.en: You can't afford it.
sentences.zh: 你负担不起。

sentences.en: And so they hold it there so that the very grassroots that they say they want to engage can have no say, no part, no even ability to watch anything because they can't get there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把它办在那里，这样他们声称想要接触的草根阶层就无法参与，无法介入，甚至因为无法到达现场而无法观看任何东西。

sentences.en: Then what's even worse than that, the speakers at the event are all Rana supporters.
sentences.zh: 然后更糟糕的是，活动上的发言人都是罗娜的支持者。

sentences.en: The speaker at Thursday's dinner is Kellyanne Conway, who the RNC paid $800,000 to her in consulting fees.
sentences.zh: 周四晚宴的发言人是凯莉安·康威，共和党全国委员会支付了她80万美元的咨询费。

sentences.en: I mean, it is just one big awash in grift is what you've got going on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你所看到的完全是一场充斥着欺诈的闹剧。

sentences.en: They don't want any transparency.
sentences.zh: 他们不想要任何透明度。

sentences.en: Why do you think they're doing that?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: Because she has no record to run on.
sentences.zh: 因为她没有什么政绩可言。

sentences.en: She's lost five consecutive elections if you take the two Georgia runoffs.
sentences.zh: 如果算上佐治亚州的两次决选，她已经连续输掉了五场选举。

sentences.en: I guess a question I have is, how are those five elections her fault, but they're not Donald Trump's fault?
sentences.zh: 我想问的是，那五场选举怎么就是她的错，而不是唐纳德·特朗普的错？

sentences.en: Why does she get blamed for those elections?
sentences.zh: 为什么她要为那些选举背锅？

sentences.en: She's the chairman of the RNC.
sentences.zh: 她是共和党全国委员会的主席。

sentences.en: If you want to blame Trump, don't vote for him in the upcoming primaries.
sentences.zh: 如果你想责怪特朗普，就不要在即将到来的初选中投票给他。

sentences.en: That's your choice.
sentences.zh: 那是你的选择。

sentences.en: You can do that, right?
sentences.zh: 你可以那样做，对吧？

sentences.en: There's going to be challenges, and you can vote for someone else if you think he's the reason, right?
sentences.zh: 会有挑战者，如果你认为他是原因，你可以投票给别人，对吧？

sentences.en: I happen to not think he is.
sentences.zh: 我碰巧不认为他是。

sentences.en: But she is the chairman of the Republican National Committee.
sentences.zh: 但她是共和党全国委员会的主席。

sentences.en: She's done nothing on ballot harvesting.
sentences.zh: 她在选票收集方面什么都没做。

sentences.en: She hasn't done anything in any of the critical areas.
sentences.zh: 她在任何关键领域都没有做任何事情。

sentences.en: Independent of how you feel about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 无论你对唐纳德·特朗普感觉如何。

sentences.en: Independent of, she has, we need someone else.
sentences.zh: 除了她之外，我们还需要其他人。

sentences.en: Look, this is a movement.
sentences.zh: 听着，这是一场运动。

sentences.en: America First is a movement of working people that want their jobs back.
sentences.zh: “美国优先”是一场属于工薪阶层的运动，他们想要回自己的工作。

sentences.en: They want to take care of their families.
sentences.zh: 他们想要照顾好自己的家庭。

sentences.en: They don't want the kids groomed in school.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望孩子在学校里被灌输那些东西。

sentences.en: They don't want to compete with low-wage immigrants for jobs, right?
sentences.zh: 他们不想为了工作而与低薪移民竞争，对吧？

sentences.en: They want to stay out of these wars.
sentences.zh: 他们想远离这些战争。

sentences.en: They don't want to be sending tanks at, you know, hundreds of millions of dollars of their money to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他们不想把数亿美元的钱，你知道的，拿去给乌克兰买坦克。

sentences.en: They want to live their life and make a better wage.
sentences.zh: 他们只想过好自己的生活，赚取更好的工资。

sentences.en: And then we're trying to take over the Republican Party because what it represents right now is the Mitt Romney elites, right?
sentences.zh: 我们正试图接管共和党，因为现在的共和党代表的是罗姆尼那样的精英阶层，对吧？

sentences.en: We go to the infield of NASCAR and grill hot dogs and Mitt Romney goes to the box of the owner of the Jets, right?
sentences.zh: 我们去纳斯卡赛车的内场烤热狗，而罗姆尼却坐在喷气机队老板的包厢里，对吧？

sentences.en: That's the disconnect.
sentences.zh: 这就是脱节所在。

sentences.en: And they're still in that world.
sentences.zh: 他们还活在那个世界里。

sentences.en: They don't get it.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不懂。

sentences.en: And eventually we're going to take over the Republican Party as a vehicle, right?
sentences.zh: 最终，我们要把共和党当作一个载体来接管，对吧？

sentences.en: As a vehicle for our movement.
sentences.zh: 作为我们运动的载体。

sentences.en: How do you expect, where do you expect that kind of energy to go?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种能量会流向何处？

sentences.en: Is it just waiting for the primary?
sentences.zh: 只是在等待初选吗？

sentences.en: Is it to back to Trump's campaign?
sentences.zh: 还是回归特朗普的竞选活动？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: No, this is about bigger stuff than that.
sentences.zh: 不，这关乎比那更宏大的事情。

sentences.en: People have changed.
sentences.zh: 人们已经变了。

sentences.en: The movement has eclipsed all of its current leaders.
sentences.zh: 这场运动已经超越了它目前所有的领导者。

sentences.en: Including Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 包括唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: It's eclipsed them all.
sentences.zh: 它超越了所有人。

sentences.en: Trump is now one of the leaders.
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在只是领导者之一。

sentences.en: He was the leader.
sentences.zh: 他曾经是唯一的领导者。

sentences.en: Now the president is a key leader, right?
sentences.zh: 现在总统是一位关键的领导者，对吧？

sentences.en: This is not defined anymore by its leaders.
sentences.zh: 这场运动不再由其领导者来定义了。

sentences.en: That's the most important thing to realize.
sentences.zh: 这是最重要的一点。

sentences.en: And the movement itself is becoming the it.
sentences.zh: 运动本身正在成为核心。

sentences.en: When do you think that shifted?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种转变是什么时候发生的？

sentences.en: I think it shifted during McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 我认为是在麦卡锡事件期间。

sentences.en: I mean, look, I'm sure that I'm going to be playing a role in the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听着，我肯定会在竞选活动中发挥作用。

sentences.en: I'm for Trump, no question.
sentences.zh: 我支持特朗普，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: You know, his surrogates are here, all friends of mine, lobbying behind the scenes for Rana.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的代理人都在这儿，都是我的朋友，在幕后为拉娜游说。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 那没关系。

sentences.en: They've got a right to do that.
sentences.zh: 他们有权这样做。

sentences.en: But they can't control the grassroots.
sentences.zh: 但他们无法控制基层民众。

sentences.en: We have gotten so many people involved in the party at the local level.
sentences.zh: 我们已经让很多人参与到地方层面的党务中了。

sentences.en: It's over.
sentences.zh: 一切都结束了。

sentences.en: And what we saw here today is you've got 100 people came.
sentences.zh: 今天我们看到这里来了100个人。

sentences.en: All I did was announce it on my radio and TV show.
sentences.zh: 我所做的只是在我的广播和电视节目中宣布了一下。

sentences.en: And they just drove here.
sentences.zh: 他们就直接开车过来了。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because we got them involved and they're cut out of the process.
sentences.zh: 因为我们让他们参与了进来，而他们之前被排除在进程之外。

sentences.en: And they want in.
sentences.zh: 他们想要参与其中。

sentences.en: They want to know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And they want transparency, right?
sentences.zh: 他们想要透明度，对吧？

sentences.en: They're crowding us out.
sentences.zh: 他们正在把我们挤出去。

sentences.en: So before we've even gotten to the RNC meeting, here's what we've learned.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们参加共和党全国委员会会议之前，我们已经了解到了这些。

sentences.en: For grassroots conservatives, the midterms were not a rejection of their movement.
sentences.zh: 对于基层保守派来说，中期选举并非是对他们运动的否定。

sentences.en: My name is Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 我叫凯特琳。

sentences.en: I'm with the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: And I was just, do you have a couple minutes to chat?
sentences.zh: 我只是想问，你有几分钟时间聊聊吗？

sentences.en: I'm just curious what brought people here.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇是什么把大家带到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Sunny Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 我是桑尼·施密特。

sentences.en: I live here in Dana Point.
sentences.zh: 我住在达纳角。

sentences.en: And I just found out about this this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上才听说这件事。

sentences.en: And so, I mean, Ronald McDaniel is just ruining the party.
sentences.zh: 我是说，罗纳·麦克丹尼尔正在毁掉这个党。

sentences.en: So we definitely need a fighter for the people.
sentences.zh: 所以我们绝对需要一个为人民而战的斗士。

sentences.en: That's why I'm here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我来这里的原因。

sentences.en: The election was still stolen.
sentences.zh: 选举依然是被窃取的。

sentences.en: And the establishment is still to blame.
sentences.zh: 建制派依然难辞其咎。

sentences.en: I've been watching.
sentences.zh: 我一直在观察。

sentences.en: I've never paid much attention to politics, period, until 2016, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，在2016年之前，我从未真正关注过政治。

sentences.en: And now I almost listen to it, watch it nonstop.
sentences.zh: 而现在我几乎不停地在听、在看。

sentences.en: Because it matters.
sentences.zh: 因为这很重要。

sentences.en: And we matter.
sentences.zh: 我们也很重要。

sentences.en: And the country is going straight to hell if we don't take over.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不接管，这个国家就彻底完了。

sentences.en: I mean, the RNC's done a terrible job.
sentences.zh: 我是说，共和党全国委员会的工作做得太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And it's because of leadership.
sentences.zh: 这都是因为领导层的问题。

sentences.en: And if either one of these other folks get in, we win.
sentences.zh: 如果其他候选人中的任何一个能当选，我们就赢了。

sentences.en: And if they team up, all the better.
sentences.zh: 如果他们联手，那就更好了。

sentences.en: Harmeet and Mike are both grassroots.
sentences.zh: 哈米特和迈克都是基层出身。

sentences.en: They're for the people, not for the machine.
sentences.zh: 他们是为人民服务的，而不是为机器服务的。

sentences.en: I'm curious about your feelings about President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我对你对特朗普总统的看法很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Do you want him to get another term?
sentences.zh: 你希望他再连任一届吗？

sentences.en: And while many of them...
sentences.zh: 虽然他们中的许多人……

sentences.en: I am a Trumper all the way.
sentences.zh: 我一直都是特朗普的坚定支持者。

sentences.en: ...still love Trump.
sentences.zh: ……仍然爱着特朗普。

sentences.en: He won.
sentences.zh: 他赢了。

sentences.en: So I'm juSt...
sentences.zh: 所以我只是……

sentences.en: They just need to put him back in.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要让他重回职位。

sentences.en: Here's what feels new.
sentences.zh: 这就是新鲜之处。

sentences.en: I'm increasingly hearing the grassroots remind us of an important fact.
sentences.zh: 我越来越多地听到基层民众提醒我们一个重要的事实。

sentences.en: And anybody who's for America, I don't care if it's Trump, anybody.
sentences.zh: 任何支持美国的人，我不在乎是不是特朗普，任何人都行。

sentences.en: America first candidates.
sentences.zh: “美国优先”的候选人。

sentences.en: Their movement predates Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们的运动早于特朗普。

sentences.en: Predates any one leader.
sentences.zh: 早于任何一位领导者。

sentences.en: Very different from my comrades.
sentences.zh: 这和我的同志们很不一样。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm not a Trump fan.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不是特朗普的粉丝。

sentences.en: And some of them are even saying...
sentences.zh: 他们中有些人甚至说……

sentences.en: We want DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 我们想要德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: I want DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 我想要德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: DeSantis is very, very shrewd.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯非常精明。

sentences.en: And he's common sense.
sentences.zh: 而且他很有常识。

sentences.en: And he knows how to get things done.
sentences.zh: 他知道如何把事情办成。

sentences.en: He also knows how to work with media.
sentences.zh: 他也知道如何与媒体打交道。

sentences.en: They're willing to move on without him.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意在没有他的情况下继续前进。

sentences.en: This feels big.
sentences.zh: 这感觉意义重大。

sentences.en: It's something we really haven't seen in the past six years.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在过去六年里从未见过的。

sentences.en: Good point.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: But I still disagree.
sentences.zh: 但我还是不同意。

sentences.en: I still like Trump.
sentences.zh: 我依然喜欢特朗普。

sentences.en: I'm willing to hear other viewpoints.
sentences.zh: 我愿意听取其他观点。

sentences.en: And I still love you.
sentences.zh: 我也依然爱你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: You figured out those shits a lot faster than that.
sentences.zh: 你弄懂那些换挡比那快多了。

sentences.en: The gear shits.
sentences.zh: 换挡装置。

sentences.en: That thing.
sentences.zh: 那个东西。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I did feel...
sentences.zh: 我确实感觉到……

sentences.en: So the next day, we head to the Waldorf Astoria.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我们前往华尔道夫酒店。

sentences.en: It's day two.
sentences.zh: 这是第二天。

sentences.en: We're about to go talk to some establishment people.
sentences.zh: 我们准备去和一些建制派人士交谈。

sentences.en: Can you sort of contrast what we heard yesterday with what you think we will hear at this event?
sentences.zh: 你能对比一下我们昨天听到的，和你认为我们在这次活动中会听到的内容吗？

sentences.en: Yesterday was a group of outsiders.
sentences.zh: 昨天是一群局外人。

sentences.en: You know, John Fredericks is hosting that event at a hotel that's near the event, but not at the host site.
sentences.zh: 你知道，约翰·弗雷德里克斯在酒店举办那场活动，地点靠近主会场，但不在主办方场地内。

sentences.en: He is hosting a group for the public.
sentences.zh: 他正在为公众举办一场聚会。

sentences.en: And these are people who are used to pressuring the establishment in ways that are uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 这些人习惯于以令人不适的方式向建制派施压。

sentences.en: Today, I think we'll hear from the people who make the decisions, but also the folks who are trying to toggle the line between the Republican Party's kind of elite donors,
sentences.zh: 今天，我想我们会听到决策者们的声音，还有那些试图在共和党精英捐赠者、

sentences.en: Republican Party's most important political figures, and the grassroots.
sentences.zh: 共和党最重要的政治人物以及基层民众之间走钢丝的人。

sentences.en: So whereas yesterday is all about what they believe in and what they think is right,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果说昨天的主题是关于他们的信仰和他们认为正确的事情，

sentences.en: today is going to be about people who are trying to think of just what's best for the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 那么今天的主题将是关于那些试图思考对共和党最有利的人。

sentences.en: And I think that's a difference in how those two groups think.
sentences.zh: 我认为这两群人的思维方式存在差异。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: Honestly, Fredericks is right.
sentences.zh: 老实说，弗雷德里克斯是对的。

sentences.en: The RNC is exclusive.
sentences.zh: 共和党全国委员会是排外的。

sentences.en: 168 voting members decide on a secret ballot who gets to be party chair.
sentences.zh: 168名投票成员通过无记名投票决定谁能担任党主席。

sentences.en: And it's this sort of thing that the grassroots hates.
sentences.zh: 而这正是基层民众所厌恶的事情。

sentences.en: And here we are.
sentences.zh: 我们现在就在这里。

sentences.en: As we're entering the hotel, security guards won't let us bring in our microphones, so we have to record on our phones.
sentences.zh: 当我们进入酒店时，保安不让我们带麦克风进去，所以我们只能用手机录音。

sentences.en: And just inside the front doors, we see some RNC members in the lounge, taking a break from their closed-door meetings.
sentences.zh: 就在前门内，我们看到休息室里有一些共和党全国委员会成员，他们正在闭门会议的间隙休息。

sentences.en: Can you just identify yourself on tape, just so that we have you saying your name and what you do, where you're from?
sentences.zh: 你能对着录音机自报家门吗？就是说出你的名字、职位和来自哪里？

sentences.en: Yeah, and my self-security number members.
sentences.zh: 好的，还有我的安全号码成员。

sentences.en: Just the last four days.
sentences.zh: 就最后四位数字。

sentences.en: Yeah, the last four days.
sentences.zh: 是的，最后四位。

sentences.en: It's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: My name is Oscar Brock.
sentences.zh: 我叫奥斯卡·布洛克。

sentences.en: I'm from Chattanooga, Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 我来自田纳西州查塔努加。

sentences.en: My blood type is A-5.
sentences.zh: 我的血型是A-5。

sentences.en: And what's your title?
sentences.zh: 你的头衔是什么？

sentences.en: I'm National Committee Man from Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 我是田纳西州的全国委员会委员。

sentences.en: We find Oscar Brock near the bar.
sentences.zh: 我们在酒吧附近找到了奥斯卡·布洛克。

sentences.en: Like a lot of RNC members, he's kind of a political lifer.
sentences.zh: 像许多共和党全国委员会成员一样，他算是个政坛老手。

sentences.en: No, I was raised in politics.
sentences.zh: 不，我是在政治环境中长大的。

sentences.en: I came from a political family.
sentences.zh: 我来自一个政治家庭。

sentences.en: My dad ran for Congress when I was in the womb.
sentences.zh: 我父亲在我还在娘胎里时就竞选过国会议员。

sentences.en: I was born about a month after he won his first race.
sentences.zh: 他赢得第一次竞选大约一个月后，我就出生了。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I lived my life on jet airplanes and traveling to and from D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我的一生都是在喷气式飞机上度过的，往返于华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: From conversations we had before arriving, we know a lot of these folks are hesitant to talk to media about who they're supporting in the chair race.
sentences.zh: 从我们到达前进行的交谈中，我们了解到这些人中有很多对于向媒体透露他们在主席竞选中支持谁感到犹豫。

sentences.en: But Brock is a big exception to that.
sentences.zh: 但布洛克是个很大的例外。

sentences.en: He'd come onto our radar because of an email he sent to other RNC members, saying it was time to ditch Ronna McDaniel.
sentences.zh: 他进入我们的视野是因为他给其他共和党全国委员会成员发了一封电子邮件，说现在是时候抛弃罗娜·麦克丹尼尔了。

sentences.en: One thing I was talking to someone yesterday about was they didn't expect McDaniel to run again in 2020.
sentences.zh: 昨天我和某人谈到的一件事是，他们没想到麦克丹尼尔会在2020年再次参选。

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我也没有想到。

sentences.en: In fact, I talked to staff members and I said, what are you going to be doing next year?
sentences.zh: 事实上，我和工作人员谈过，我问他们，明年你们打算做什么？

sentences.en: And they said, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 他们说，你是什么意思？

sentences.en: We're running again.
sentences.zh: 我们要再次参选。

sentences.en: And I'm like, why in the world were you running again?
sentences.zh: 我说，你们到底为什么要再次参选？

sentences.en: Can you tell me why were you surprised?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我你为什么感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: So, one, we'd lost two cycles in a row.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们已经连续输掉了两个周期。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Now, whether or not you can blame Ronna or you need to blame someone else becomes irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 现在，无论你是否能责怪罗娜，或者你需要责怪别人，这都无关紧要了。

sentences.zh: 而这显然是不真实的，对吧？

sentences.zh: 关于这场主席之争，有趣的是，从纸面上看，麦克丹尼尔和迪伦看起来有点相似。

sentences.zh: 她们都是共和党全国委员会成员。

sentences.zh: 她们都与特朗普世界有联系。

sentences.zh: 即使在我们的支持者中，也有那种非常疯狂的、认为1月6日是美国历史上伟大一天的那些人。

sentences.en: And we have the, you know, January 6th was truly an insurrection people on the team.

sentences.en: I mean, and we've got the whole gamut.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们有各种各样的人。

sentences.zh: 我们有一位女士帮助组织了1月6日的“停止窃选”集会。

sentences.zh: 你知道，那个昨天唯一要说的话就是选举是假的，除此之外别无他学的人。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.zh: 迈克·林德尔在第一街的共和党全国委员会大楼四楼不会有办公室。

sentences.zh: 你认为如果哈米特当选，她会以任何方式受制于那些人吗？

sentences.zh: 即特朗普的基层支持。

sentences.zh: 我猜大概是百分之二十几，或者30%，也许是30%。

sentences.zh: 而且我这儿风噪很大。

sentences.en: A few hours later, after we'd gone back to our own hotel, I saw a tweet from Charlie Kirk that he'd just released an interview he'd done with Governor Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，当我们回到自己的酒店时，我看到了查理·柯克发的一条推文，他刚刚发布了对罗恩·德桑蒂斯州长的采访。

sentences.en: Right now, the RNC is meeting in Dana Point, California.
sentences.zh: 目前，共和党全国委员会正在加利福尼亚州的达纳角开会。

sentences.en: And there are some questions of who should lead the RNC and whether it should be Rana for a fourth term or go a different direction with Harmeet Dillon.
sentences.zh: 关于谁应该领导共和党全国委员会，以及是应该让罗娜连任第四届，还是选择哈米特·迪伦换个方向，存在一些疑问。

sentences.en: What are your thoughts on this?
sentences.zh: 你对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: Well, we've had three substandard election cycles in a row.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们已经连续经历了三个不合格的选举周期。

sentences.en: I think we need a change.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要改变。

sentences.en: I think we need to get some new blood in the RNC.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要为共和党全国委员会注入新鲜血液。

sentences.en: I like what Harmeet Dillon has said about getting the RNC out of D.C.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢哈米特·迪伦关于让共和党全国委员会撤出华盛顿特区的说法。

sentences.en: But I do think we need some fresh thinking.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为我们需要一些新的思维。

sentences.en: And here's the thing, just practically speaking, you need grassroots Republicans to power this organization with volunteering and donations.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，从实际角度来看，你需要基层的共和党人通过志愿服务和捐款来推动这个组织。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be very difficult to energize people to want to give money, to want to volunteer their time with the RNC if they don't see a change in direction.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果人们看不到方向上的改变，就很难激励他们为共和党全国委员会捐款或贡献时间。

sentences.en: It was a forward-looking message and a clear play for Trump's base.
sentences.zh: 这是一个展望未来的信息，也是对特朗普基本盘的一次明确拉拢。

sentences.en: But it wasn't exactly the unity in this chair fight that Barbara was seeking.
sentences.zh: 但这并不完全是芭芭拉所寻求的那种主席竞选中的团结。

sentences.en: After the break.
sentences.zh: 休息之后继续。

sentences.en: Thank you, Madam Chair.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席女士。

sentences.en: Okay, folks, strap yourself in.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，坐稳了。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们要开始了。

sentences.en: The chair vote.
sentences.zh: 主席投票。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com免费直播精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: It's a very grand staircase we're walking down right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在走下的楼梯非常宏伟。

sentences.en: The next day, it's finally time for the RNC chair vote.
sentences.zh: 第二天，终于到了共和党全国委员会主席投票的时间。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: In a huge ballroom.
sentences.zh: 在一个巨大的宴会厅里。

sentences.en: It's full of RNC members and other members of the press.
sentences.zh: 里面挤满了共和党全国委员会成员和其他媒体成员。

sentences.en: At the front of the room, there's a stage and a podium.
sentences.zh: 房间前方有一个舞台和一个讲台。

sentences.en: Hanging behind the podium, there's a big red elephant logo flanked by American flags.
sentences.zh: 讲台后面悬挂着一个巨大的红色大象标志，两旁是美国国旗。

sentences.en: Ronna McDaniel takes the stage.
sentences.zh: 罗娜·麦克丹尼尔走上舞台。

sentences.en: I decided to be in California, and I know a lot of you ask, why are we in California?
sentences.zh: 我决定在加利福尼亚州举行，我知道你们很多人会问，为什么我们在加利福尼亚？

sentences.en: Because I just wanted to rub Nancy Pelosi's face in it one more time.
sentences.zh: 因为我只是想再让南希·佩洛西难堪一次。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: She is a total arm of a...
sentences.zh: 她完全是……的工具。

sentences.en: She's downplaying the midterms' losses.
sentences.zh: 她正在淡化中期选举的失利。

sentences.en: If this had been a presidential year, we would have won the Electoral College with 297 votes.
sentences.zh: 如果这是总统大选年，我们将以297张选举人票获胜。

sentences.en: That's a really good sign as we head into 2024.
sentences.zh: 在我们迈向2024年之际，这是一个非常好的迹象。

sentences.en: But most of all...
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是……

sentences.en: Nothing we do is more important than making sure that Joe Biden is a one-term president.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的一切，没有比确保乔·拜登只当一届总统更重要的了。

sentences.en: We have to be unified.
sentences.zh: 我们必须团结一致。

sentences.en: She's sticking to the party line on the importance of unity.
sentences.zh: 她坚持党内关于团结重要性的路线。

sentences.en: Reminded of a Bible verse that Abraham Lincoln famously used from the Gospel of Matthew.
sentences.zh: 我想起了亚伯拉罕·林肯曾引用过的一句《马太福音》中的圣经经文。

sentences.en: Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
sentences.zh: 凡一国自相纷争，就成为荒凉；一城一家自相纷争，必站立不住。

sentences.en: And we have got to work together.
sentences.zh: 我们必须齐心协力。

sentences.en: Thank you, Madam Chair.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席女士。

sentences.en: Okay, folks, strap yourself in.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，坐稳了。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们要开始了。

sentences.en: Then, the vote begins.
sentences.zh: 然后，投票开始。

sentences.en: Alabama, will you please come forward and cast your votes?
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马州，请上前投票好吗？

sentences.en: R&C members are called up to vote by state.
sentences.zh: 共和党全国委员会成员按州被叫去投票。

sentences.en: Everyone, can you please return your seat, guys?
sentences.zh: 各位，请回到你们的座位上，好吗？

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们要开始了。

sentences.en: Anybody sees anybody else?
sentences.zh: 有人看到其他人了吗？

sentences.en: Tell them to please return your seat.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们请回到座位上。

sentences.en: Okay, we do have results.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们有结果了。

sentences.en: Okay, 167 votes were cast, which means you need 84 to have a majority.
sentences.zh: 好了，共投出167票，这意味着你需要84票才能获得多数。

sentences.en: Mike Lindell received four votes.
sentences.zh: 迈克·林德尔获得了四票。

sentences.en: Harmeet Dillon received 51 votes.
sentences.zh: 哈米特·迪伦获得了51票。

sentences.en: And Ronna McDaniel received 111 votes.
sentences.zh: 罗娜·麦克丹尼尔获得了111票。

sentences.en: McDaniel returns to the microphone.
sentences.zh: 麦克丹尼尔回到麦克风前。

sentences.en: Can I have Harmeet up here?
sentences.zh: 能请哈米特上来吗？

sentences.en: Mike and Harmeet, can you please come up?
sentences.zh: 迈克和哈米特，能请你们上来吗？

sentences.en: We have a winner, McDaniel twins, and they have a little unity moment up there where Dillon is hugging McDaniel, and Lindell is also coming up there.
sentences.zh: 我们有了获胜者，麦克丹尼尔双胞胎，他们在台上有一个小小的团结时刻，迪伦拥抱了麦克丹尼尔，林德尔也上来了。

sentences.en: We heard the grassroots, we know.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了基层的声音，我们知道。

sentences.en: We heard Harmeet, we heard Mike Lindell.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了哈米特的声音，我们听到了迈克·林德尔的声音。

sentences.en: But with us united and all of us going together, the Democrats are going to hear us in 2020.
sentences.zh: 但只要我们团结一致，共同前进，民主党人在2020年就会听到我们的声音。

sentences.en: For McDaniel, it was a decisive statement.
sentences.zh: 对麦克丹尼尔来说，这是一个决定性的声明。

sentences.en: No matter the grassroots pressure, a strong majority of the people in this room were still behind her.
sentences.zh: 无论基层压力如何，这个房间里绝大多数人仍然支持她。

sentences.en: And not only did she win, the margin of victory was way bigger than people expected.
sentences.zh: 而且她不仅赢了，获胜的优势比人们预期的要大得多。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, what you just witnessed was the, are we on the record?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你刚才目睹的是，我们是在录音吗？

sentences.en: I'm recording, is that all right?
sentences.zh: 我在录音，这没问题吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对没问题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: As we're leaving the meeting hall, we find John Fredericks, who has made his way over to the wall door for the vote.
sentences.zh: 当我们离开会议大厅时，我们找到了约翰·弗雷德里克斯，他为了投票已经走到了墙边的门那儿。

sentences.en: Tell me when you're set.
sentences.zh: 准备好了告诉我。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What you just saw, what you just witnessed, was the greatest middle finger, the greatest New Jersey salute in the history of politics that the tone deaf, 111 of them,
sentences.zh: 你刚才看到的，你刚才目睹的，是政治史上最伟大的中指，最伟大的新泽西式敬礼，那些充耳不闻的111个人，

sentences.en: just gave to the grassroots of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 刚刚对共和党的基层做出了这种回应。

sentences.en: This vote is going to go down in history as breaking this thing up.
sentences.zh: 这次投票将作为分裂这个政党的事情载入史册。

sentences.en: It is incredible display of basically go to hell.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是一种令人难以置信的“去死吧”的姿态。

sentences.en: We're going to re-elect our chairman.
sentences.zh: 我们要重新选举我们的主席。

sentences.en: We got the perks.
sentences.zh: 我们有津贴。

sentences.en: We got the resort hotels.
sentences.zh: 我们有度假酒店。

sentences.en: We got the money.
sentences.zh: 我们有钱。

sentences.en: We got the spas.
sentences.zh: 我们有水疗中心。

sentences.en: We got the private jets.
sentences.zh: 我们有私人飞机。

sentences.en: You all can go to hell.
sentences.zh: 你们所有人都可以去死吧。

sentences.en: They don't care what we think.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不在乎我们的想法。

sentences.en: This is the most outrageous display of elitism.
sentences.zh: 这是最令人愤慨的精英主义展示。

sentences.en: This is like the Politburo at the Black Sea.
sentences.zh: 这就像黑海边的政治局一样。

sentences.en: We appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Let's go over there.
sentences.zh: 我们去那边吧。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Across the room, we spot Oscar Brock.
sentences.zh: 在房间对面，我们发现了奥斯卡·布洛克。

sentences.en: Hey, how you doing?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: Good to see you again.
sentences.zh: 很高兴再次见到你。

sentences.en: Sitting by himself at a folding table.
sentences.zh: 他独自坐在一张折叠桌旁。

sentences.en: Next to that giant staircase.
sentences.zh: 就在那个巨大的楼梯旁边。

sentences.en: Okay, so you tell me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那你告诉我。

sentences.en: Oh, please don't.
sentences.zh: 哦，求你了，别。

sentences.en: Make me relive the worst morning of my life.
sentences.zh: 让我重温我一生中最糟糕的早晨。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: I'm kidding.
sentences.zh: 我开玩笑的。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: It wasn't that bad.
sentences.zh: 没那么糟。

sentences.en: No, I mean, what's your initial takeaway?
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，你最初的看法是什么？

sentences.en: The margin was maybe bigger than expected.
sentences.zh: 优势比预期的可能要大。

sentences.en: Well, A, yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第一，是的。

sentences.en: The margin was bigger than expected.
sentences.zh: 优势比预期的要大。

sentences.en: B, I was surprised at how many people were willing to support somebody with a proven track record of losing campaigns, right?
sentences.zh: 第二，我很惊讶有多少人愿意支持一个有着失败竞选记录的人，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't have any clue.
sentences.zh: 我一点头绪都没有。

sentences.en: I, the logic that led people to support Rana, it eludes me.
sentences.zh: 我，导致人们支持罗娜的逻辑，我无法理解。

sentences.en: What do you think this means for sort of the identity of the Republican Party?
sentences.zh: 你认为这对共和党的身份意味着什么？

sentences.en: What happened today?
sentences.zh: 今天发生了什么？

sentences.en: Can, can I bring up something we talked about yesterday?
sentences.zh: 能，能提一下我们昨天谈过的事情吗？

sentences.en: Time heals all wounds.
sentences.zh: 时间能治愈一切伤口。

sentences.en: Do you still think that?
sentences.zh: 你还这么认为吗？

sentences.en: I, no, I always, I will always believe that.
sentences.zh: 我，不，我总是，我将永远相信这一点。

sentences.en: But, um, we'll get there.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，我们会达到的。

sentences.en: It just may take a little longer than I thought, four hours ago.
sentences.zh: 只是可能比我四个小时前想的要花更长的时间。

sentences.en: How long?
sentences.zh: 要多久？

sentences.en: Um, well, at least, I mean, it certainly will not happen in the next two years, because she's going to tilt the playing field totally in favor of Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 嗯，至少，我是说，这肯定不会在未来两年内发生，因为她会完全向唐纳德·特朗普倾斜竞争环境，

sentences.en: because she's totally incapable of being unbiased, right?
sentences.zh: 因为她完全无法做到不偏不倚，对吧？

sentences.en: He made her.
sentences.zh: 是他造就了她。

sentences.en: He made her into what she is.
sentences.zh: 是他把她变成了现在的样子。

sentences.en: It's, it's going to be at least 2026 before we're able to heal the party, truly.
sentences.zh: 至少要到2026年，我们才能真正治愈这个党派。

sentences.en: We're going to track the election analysis autopsy effort.
sentences.zh: 我们将追踪这次选举分析的复盘工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, good luck with that.
sentences.zh: 是啊，祝你们好运。

sentences.en: Because we're never going to tell the truth, right?
sentences.zh: 因为我们永远不会说实话，对吧？

sentences.en: We're never going to tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不会说实话。

sentences.en: That one of the big, not the only, but one of the big reasons is that Donald Trump endorsed unprepared candidates and caused them to finish first in their primaries.
sentences.zh: 其中一个重要原因——不是唯一原因，但确实是重要原因之一——是唐纳德·特朗普支持了那些毫无准备的候选人，导致他们在初选中胜出。

sentences.en: Uh, and we'll never, we'll never say that out loud, because we're stupid.
sentences.zh: 呃，我们永远不会大声说出来，因为我们太蠢了。

sentences.en: Thank you, I appreciate the time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, thanks.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I know it's a, I know it's a busy day.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我知道今天很忙。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump is going to squish me like a, hey, that means he's listening in New York.
sentences.zh: 而且唐纳德·特朗普会像捏死一只蚂蚁一样捏死我，嘿，这意味着他在纽约听着呢。

sentences.en: And just as we're about to head out.
sentences.zh: 就在我们准备离开的时候。

sentences.en: We're not going to talk for very long, right?
sentences.zh: 我们不会聊太久，对吧？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: We finally get the chance to talk to Harmeet Diller.
sentences.zh: 我们终于有机会和哈米特·迪伦谈谈了。

sentences.en: Do you worry about the grassroots potential backlash to the decision that was made?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心基层对这一决定可能产生的反弹？

sentences.en: I'm worried about it, you know, but I heard it loud and clear is one of the reasons why I ran.
sentences.zh: 我确实担心，你知道，但我听到了非常明确的声音，这也是我参选的原因之一。

sentences.en: They've been a backlash to the RNC for years, specifically after the 2020 election, but.
sentences.zh: 多年来，共和党全国委员会一直面临反弹，特别是在2020年大选之后，但是。

sentences.en: Do you think that's been building?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种情绪一直在积聚吗？

sentences.en: That was building through that.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪在那期间一直在积聚。

sentences.en: Absolutely, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是，绝对是。

sentences.en: I haven't even looked at my phone to see what the press and what the public is saying,
sentences.zh: 我甚至还没看手机，不知道媒体和公众在说什么，

sentences.en: but I have hundreds of messages from friends who are telling me that the result is very upsetting and they're disappointed.
sentences.zh: 但我收到了几百条朋友发来的信息，他们告诉我结果非常令人沮丧，他们感到很失望。

sentences.en: But as you can see in my statement, I said, I will continue to work with the RNC and we have to try to make it better as best we can,
sentences.zh: 但正如你在我的声明中所见，我说过，我将继续与共和党全国委员会合作，我们必须尽我们所能让它变得更好，

sentences.en: despite the many members here seem to be out of touch with the grassroots potential backlash.
sentences.zh: 尽管这里的许多成员似乎与基层可能产生的反弹脱节了。

sentences.en: Are you going to be trying to out there trying to stop it?
sentences.zh: 你会试着去阻止这种反弹吗？

sentences.en: Are you?
sentences.zh: 你会吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I mean, no, I mean, I'm not like going to say we're from the asteroid or anything.
sentences.zh: 我是说，不，我的意思是，我不会说我们来自小行星什么的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'll just do my best to have input where it, but, you know, this current chair runs the party in a, you know, unilateral type fashion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我会尽我所能提出意见，但是，你知道，现任主席以一种单方面的方式管理这个党派。

sentences.en: So whatever role I have is in a way at, you know, like what room she makes and then if I say yes, then that's what happens.
sentences.zh: 所以无论我扮演什么角色，在某种程度上都取决于她留出了多大的空间，如果我答应了，那事情就是那样了。

sentences.en: Are you disappointed in how the Trump campaign lended in soft support to McDaniel?
sentences.zh: 你对特朗普竞选团队向麦克丹尼尔提供软性支持感到失望吗？

sentences.en: I think that, believe me, if you go online and see what the reaction of President Trump's supporters are overwhelmingly to that choice, it's negative.
sentences.zh: 我认为，相信我，如果你上网看看特朗普总统的支持者对这一选择的反应，绝大多数都是负面的。

sentences.en: Now, by contrast, I have no relationships with Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我和罗恩·德桑蒂斯没有任何关系。

sentences.en: I think I met him once at a reception four years ago.
sentences.zh: 我想四年前我在一次招待会上见过他一次。

sentences.en: I've never spoken to him one-on-one.
sentences.zh: 我从未与他进行过一对一的交谈。

sentences.en: I have no relationship with him and he has no reason to expect I'll, given my voting history, that I'll support his campaign.
sentences.zh: 我和他没有任何关系，而且考虑到我的投票记录，他也没有理由指望我会支持他的竞选。

sentences.en: But he heard loud and clear what the, I mean, it was brilliant, actually, for any politician who wants to be the heir to the throne to say,
sentences.zh: 但他听到了非常明确的声音，我是说，对于任何想成为王位继承人的政客来说，这其实很聪明，他说，

sentences.en: hey, grassroots, I hear you loud and clear.
sentences.zh: 嘿，基层民众，我听到了你们非常明确的声音。

sentences.en: It was a win-win proposition.
sentences.zh: 这是一个双赢的提议。

sentences.en: That makes sense to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说很有道理。

sentences.en: What doesn't make sense to me is for the grassroots president that was Donald Trump to not make that decision.
sentences.zh: 让我无法理解的是，作为基层总统的唐纳德·特朗普竟然没有做出那个决定。

sentences.en: Well, that was, uh, I cannot answer for that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是，呃，我无法回答这个问题。

sentences.en: I have nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 我与此无关。

sentences.en: I got some angry messages from inside the Mar-a-Lago team yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天我收到了一些来自海湖庄园团队内部的愤怒信息。

sentences.en: My partners did, too.
sentences.zh: 我的合伙人也收到了。

sentences.en: Whatever.
sentences.zh: 随它去吧。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: Does it affect how you think about 2020?
sentences.zh: 这会影响你对2020年的看法吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: No?
sentences.zh: 不会？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: Look, people make mistakes and miscalculations.
sentences.zh: 听着，人们都会犯错和误判。

sentences.en: I don't control them.
sentences.zh: 我无法控制他们。

sentences.en: I can only control what I do.
sentences.zh: 我只能控制我自己的行为。

sentences.en: And so, I will keep on keeping on.
sentences.zh: 所以，我会继续坚持下去。

sentences.en: Given the party's calls for unity, I was interested in Dylan's take on the 2022 autopsy, before she announced her chair candidacy.
sentences.zh: 鉴于党内呼吁团结，在迪伦宣布竞选主席之前，我对她对2022年复盘报告的看法很感兴趣。

sentences.en: You were named to be part of the folks who were looking at the last election, the group kind of doing that analysis.
sentences.zh: 你被点名加入那些审视上次选举的人员名单，就是那个进行分析的小组。

sentences.en: McDaniel had tapped Dylan to chair that report, along with Henry Barber.
sentences.zh: 麦克丹尼尔曾邀请迪伦与亨利·巴伯一起主持那份报告。

sentences.en: One of the things that the Times wants to do is track the Republican kind of, uh, efforts to look at the last election and heading into the next one.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》想要做的事情之一，就是追踪共和党在审视上次选举并展望下一次选举方面的努力。

sentences.en: I feel like the work that you are about to do, that Barber's about to do, is really important to that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你即将要做的工作，巴伯即将要做的工作，对此非常重要。

sentences.en: Do you see it as that important?
sentences.zh: 你认为它有那么重要吗？

sentences.en: Or do you think that's just another sheet of paper from the RNC that might be ripped up?
sentences.zh: 还是你认为那只是共和党全国委员会又一张可能会被撕掉的废纸？

sentences.en: Well, I probably shouldn't answer that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我可能不该回答这个问题。

sentences.en: No, I wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 不，我不会回答。

sentences.en: It's important.
sentences.zh: 它很重要。

sentences.en: All I'm going to say is, and you can take my implication, I've served on many committees before at the RNC.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，你可以领会我的言外之意，我之前在共和党全国委员会担任过许多委员会的职务。

sentences.en: And I chose to run for chair because I didn't like the way certain things were being done.
sentences.zh: 我选择竞选主席是因为我不喜欢某些事情的处理方式。

sentences.en: There are a lot of committees, and little has changed in the six years I've been in the RNC.
sentences.zh: 有很多委员会，但在我进入共和党全国委员会的六年里，几乎没有什么改变。

sentences.en: So, we'll look for this one.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们会关注这一次。

sentences.en: I appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 真的非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: So, Ested, tell me about the day we just had.
sentences.zh: 那么，埃斯特德，跟我说说我们刚度过的一天吧。

sentences.en: Um, we are leaving the Republican Winter Meeting, and we had an interesting day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们正在离开共和党冬季会议，我们度过了有趣的一天。

sentences.en: I mean, Barbara talked about the chair race as being the first step toward unity.
sentences.zh: 我是说，芭芭拉谈到主席竞选是迈向团结的第一步。

sentences.en: And if that's true, you can see how hard this is going to be.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，你可以看出这会有多困难。

sentences.en: This week, we found a party that was being pretty honest about the situation it's in,
sentences.zh: 本周，我们发现这个党派对自己所处的境地相当诚实，

sentences.en: the Trump problem it faces, and it's small window to put together a winning coalition ahead of 2024.
sentences.zh: 它面临的特朗普问题，以及在2024年之前组建获胜联盟的窗口期很小。

sentences.en: But knowing there's a problem is different than finding a solution.
sentences.zh: 但知道有问题和找到解决方案是两码事。

sentences.en: It shows me that the Republican Party's identity crisis is more than just grassroots versus establishment or Trump and anti-Trump.
sentences.zh: 这向我表明，共和党的身份危机不仅仅是基层与建制派，或者是特朗普与反特朗普之间的矛盾。

sentences.en: There are so many factions, and all of them are having a kind of intra-party squabble right now.
sentences.zh: 这里有太多的派系，他们现在都在进行某种党内争吵。

sentences.en: What's going to clean that up is the presidential primary, but how that goes threatens to be so ugly, so divisive, that it has even the people in here really nervous.
sentences.zh: 总统初选会清理这一切，但初选的过程可能会变得非常丑陋、非常分裂，以至于连这里的人都感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: So, I just think mess is in our future.
sentences.zh: 所以，我只是认为我们的未来充满了混乱。

sentences.en: We're coming.
sentences.zh: 我们要走了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 走吧。

sentences.en: We're ready.
sentences.zh: 我们准备好了。

sentences.en: Oh, we're back to the Waldorf Astoria.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们回到华尔道夫酒店了。

sentences.en: I don't know when I'll be back here.
sentences.zh: 不知道我什么时候会再回来这里。

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 永远不会。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: This might be it for me and you, Waldorf.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我和你的最后一次了，华尔道夫。
